title: Welcome to SRINEET!
message: Tumhara complete NEET preparation partner. Test Series, PYQs, Notes — sab ek jagah. Apna progress track karo, XP kamao, streak banao. Chalo shuru karte hain — All the best! 🚀

title: XP Coins & Levels
message: Har sahi answer par ab 4 XP milega. My Progress page par apna Level aur Total XP dekho!

title: Dark Mode
message: Poori site ab dark mode mein bhi chalti hai — hamburger menu mein switch on karo.

title: My Progress + Streak
message: Ab apna test history, accuracy aur daily streak track kar sakte ho — My Progress page par.
